subject: Student Advisory Council Policy Proposals
overview: The Student Advisory Council met with the School Committee to present proposed revisions to district-wide backpack and homework policies. The council also highlighted high school bus safety concerns and presented a new visualization of student advocacy channels.

items.title: Introduction of New Committee Members
items.summary: The meeting opened with introductions for newly elected School Committee members Erika Reinfeld, Aaron Olapade, and John Intoppa.

items.title: Backpack Policy Repeal Proposal
items.summary: Students presented a petition to repeal the current backpack restrictions, arguing the policy complicates the transport of heavy binders and school-issued technology between classes.

items.title: Homework Policy Revisions
items.summary: The council presented a draft policy aimed at eliminating 'busy work,' protecting student time during vacations, and standardizing makeup work for students who are sick.

items.title: High School Transportation and Bus Safety
items.summary: Administration announced an upcoming audit by Safe Routes to School after students raised safety concerns about dangerous crowding and irregular MBTA service at bus loading zones.

items.title: Student Voice Flowchart
items.summary: Darren Truong presented a flowchart clarifying the pathways for student-led advocacy; the administration agreed to consider hosting the graphic on the district website for better transparency.
